store_description: Curated, gamepad-shell-tested game snaps for handheld devices running gamepad-shell.

games.name: antsy-alien-attack-pico
games.title: Antsy Alien Attack Pico
games.summary: A retro-style vertically scrolling shoot 'em up
games.description:
The year is 2139. Planet Earth is under attack by aliens, and they're (still) antsy!

You're a mercenary with a state-of-the-art space fighter and a gun for hire. The United Federation of Planet Earth has hired you to dispatch the aliens and restore calm. Complete every mission to fulfil your contract and earn your pay.

One ship. One life. One mission. Destroy aliens by shooting or colliding with them, or avoid them if you can't destroy them. Collect power-ups to enhance your weapons and charge the ship dynamo - a fully charged dynamo boosts your shields by 50%, but weapons go offline when travelling at hyperspeed. When your ship health is depleted, you're lost to the vacuum of space.

Antsy Alien Attack Pico works with most game controllers - move with the d-pad or left stick, A or B to fire. It is a "sequel" to Antsy Alien Attack, developed during Linux Game Jam 2023 using PICO-8.

games.name: foam-frenzy
games.title: Foam Frenzy
games.summary: Foam dart blaster battles for up to eight friends, on one screen or many.
games.description:
Foam Frenzy is a fast, silly foam dart party game for 2 to 8 campers. Dash around the gym or the test lab, scoop up darts, dive out of the way and tag your friends before the clock runs out. Every dart you fire lands on the floor, so ammo is precious and anyone can grab it.

- Four modes: Free-for-all, Team Battle, Capture the Flag and Dart Hoarder
- Play on one screen with a controller each, on your local network, or online through a LinuxGroove game server
- Fill empty spots with bots, or warm up in a guided practice round
- Made for controllers and handhelds, fully playable with a keyboard

games.name: gamepad-2048
games.title: 2048 - Gamepad
games.summary: A beautiful 2048 game, tuned for game controllers
games.description:
gamepad-2048 is a fun, full-featured take on the classic 2048 sliding-tile puzzle, written in Rust and GTK4. It borrows its colour palette and visual language from gamepad-shell, making it a natural fit as a bundled example game for that shell, while still being perfectly playable with a keyboard on a regular desktop.

Features:
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6 board sizes, each with its own win target
- Full game-controller support (D-pad and left stick to move, A/Start to confirm, B/Select to go back) alongside keyboard controls
- Persistent high-score tracking per board size
- A slick, animated UI styled after the Ubuntu "Resolute Raccoon" gamepad-shell theme

games.name: gamepad-minecraft
games.title: Minecraft - Gamepad
games.summary: A controller-friendly Minecraft Java launcher for handhelds
games.description:
Play Minecraft Java Edition entirely with a gamepad - no keyboard or mouse required. Built for handheld gaming PCs like the Lenovo Legion Go S and MSI Claw, gamepad-minecraft lets you sign in once with your Microsoft account using a simple on-screen QR code, then play offline afterward with your saved profile. It also sets up your game so that Minecraft's own menus and title screen are fully navigable with a controller, not just the launcher itself.

Minecraft Java Edition itself is not included with this app - the first launch downloads it directly from Mojang, the same as the official launcher.

games.name: graveyard-hollow
games.title: Graveyard Hollow
games.summary: Keep the village lanterns lit until dawn while a friend blows them out.
games.description:
Graveyard Hollow is a social deduction party game for 4 to 10 players. At night the villagers keep the lanterns burning and finish their chores, while one or two secret Hollow snuff the lights and take villagers in the dark. Find a friend's empty lantern, ring the bell, argue it out, and vote.

- Play on your local network, each on your own device, or online through a LinuxGroove game server
- Fill empty seats with bots; with enough memory they think and talk in meetings using a small language model that runs on your own machine (embedded Lemonade Server, downloaded on first use)
- Made for controllers and handhelds, fully playable with a keyboard

games.name: steam
games.title: Steam
games.summary: Launcher for the Steam software distribution service
games.description:
Steam is a software distribution service with an online store, automated installation, automatic updates, achievements, SteamCloud synchronized savegame and screenshot functionality, and many social features.

This package is maintained by Canonical and not officially supported by Valve. Please report any issues through the contact or website links.

games.name: supertux
games.title: SuperTux
games.summary: SuperTux is a open-source classic 2D jump'n run sidescroller game in a style similar to the original Super Mario games
games.description:
SuperTux is a jump'n'run game with strong inspiration from the Super Mario Bros. games for the various Nintendo platforms.

Run and jump through multiple worlds, fighting off enemies by jumping on them, bumping them from below or tossing objects at them, grabbing power-ups and other stuff on the way.

In addition to the Story Mode, there is a large amount of community contributed levels available as add-ons or in the forums. Everyone can contribute such content by using the integrated level editor.

games.name: supertuxkart
games.title: SuperTuxKart
games.summary: A 3D arcade racer with a variety of characters, tracks, and modes to play
games.description:
Karts. Nitro. Action! SuperTuxKart is a 3D open-source arcade racer with a variety of characters, tracks, and modes to play. Our aim is to create a game that is more fun than realistic, and provide an enjoyable experience for all ages.

Discover the mystery of an underwater world, or drive through the jungles of Val Verde and visit the famous Cocoa Temple. Race underground or in a spaceship, through a rural farmland or a strange alien planet. Or rest under the palm trees on the beach, watching the other karts overtake you. But don't eat the bananas! Watch for bowling balls, plungers, bubble gum, and cakes thrown by your opponents.

You can do a single race against other karts, compete in one of several Grand Prix, try to beat the high score in time trials on your own, play battle mode against the computer or your friends, and more! For a greater challenge, race online against players from all over the world and prove your racing prowess!
